subject: ela
cluster: Research to build and present knowledge
intro: Fifth graders gather information from experiences and from print and digital sources, summarize or paraphrase information in notes and finished work, and provide a list of sources. Paraphrasing puts a fact in your own words; summarizing shortens it to the key points. Providing sources shows where facts came from and avoids copying.

items.prompt:
Read.

The blue whale is the largest animal ever known to have lived, even bigger than the largest dinosaurs.

Paraphrase this in your own words.

steps: I keep the meaning but change the words.
So: 'The blue whale is the biggest animal that has ever existed, larger than any dinosaur.'
solution.answer: The blue whale is the biggest animal to ever exist, larger than any dinosaur.

items.prompt: Why should a researcher provide a list of SOURCES?

steps: A source list shows where facts came from and gives credit.
So it credits the authors and avoids copying (plagiarism).
solution.answer: To credit the sources and show where facts came from.

items.prompt: Which is a good note: copying a whole paragraph, or writing the key point in your own words?

steps: Good notes summarize or paraphrase in your own words.
So writing the key point in your own words is best.
solution.answer: Writing the key point in your own words.

items.prompt: Putting a fact in your own words is ____.
Shortening text to key points is ____.
A list of where facts came from is a list of ____.
